objective: Implement a generic candidate-finalization and acceptance-bundle bridge that closes Plan to execution without inferred fields, substituted consumers, stale IDs, or version splits.

units.scope: derive and bind joined_driver_digest in the canonical fixture/producer and restore the complete preacceptance suite
units.validation: 20-test preacceptance suite PASS with no fixture setup errors

units.scope: add only Plan-owned declarations, explicit authority owners, epoch domains, stage topology, derivation rules and candidate materialization contracts while preserving v1
units.validation: schema tests plus authored-live-independent ownership negatives

units.scope: consume validated Plan plus isolated produced outputs; resolve exact postimages, installed consumers and deterministic IDs; publish nothing on failure
derive execution-entry rehearsal and eligibility with exact driver request/receipt/join identities and completed-prefix support
units.validation: joined-driver, stream, frontier, ordinal, suffix and stale-ref matrix

units.behavior: actual closeout and terminal transformation consumers
units.scope: replace schema-only substitution with production no-effect transformations while retaining schema checks
units.validation: schema-only substitution blocks; actual precloseout/Invoke/terminal/continuity chain passes

units.scope: select and implement one end-to-end request, response, validator and accepted-stream bridge version family
units.validation: cross-version combinations block; selected family emits, validates and bridges exactly

units.scope: atomically publish closure preparation; join independently materialized review/adoption; emit exactly one request after all PASS
units.validation: review, adoption, graph, stale epoch, request-before-review and duplicate-request negatives

units.behavior: full cross-capability regression and Laboratory proof
units.scope: run complete negative denominator twice, arbitrary frontiers/completed prefixes, installed mirror equality, one-SWU then three-SWU positive fixtures
units.validation: all negatives block before request/write; positives PASS twice with no authority effects

first_unit_rationale: PCS-001 restores the already-broken canonical regression before new contracts can rely on it.
continuous_execution_policy: A later Invoke Plan may authorize the exact eight-unit candidate as one accepted finite stream; continue only while graph, authority, baselines, versions and acceptance-critical validation remain exact.
